code_comment.comment: SV-8683 Phase 5 / FR-050 — the "Received later" role-editor checkbox. The 44th bundle. OFF by default in EVERY role: no entry in RoleFePermissionMappings carries it, so no default role's resolved atom set changes and IntentionalAtomChanges needs no ADDED_BY_DESIGN whitelist entry. It is the only thing standing between a user and bypassing the vendor-bill requirement (plan §9), so it must be granted deliberately.

SV-8911 — gates moving labor between WO lines. A WO sub-setting rather than a Work Order Lines CRUD level, because a shop must be able to grant line/labor editing without move-labor (the two were fused before).

Accounting-split F1 — the 44th bundle; gates the standalone accounting module (`/accounting` FE route group + `ANY /api/accounting/{path}` BFF proxy). Cross-repo contract: the FE `Permission` union carries this exact string, so renaming it silently shuts the route gate.
SV-8098 — the 43rd bundle; gates the QuickBooks / Integrations settings section independently of settingsParts / settingsFinance.

accountingView.comment: Accounting-split F1: accounting module page gate. Admin is the canonical full-access role and holds every module gate.

accountingSalesView.comment: Accounting (2026-09-10): Admin holds every accounting area bundle EXCEPT hrPageAccess (HR module launches dark — granted to nobody). The door itself is accountingView above. All 10 other default roles hold none ("default off"); shops grant accounting access by editing role bundles in the Accounting section of the role editor. This one list feeds BOTH the default system role (InsertDefaultRolesCommand) and the template snapshot (InsertRoleTemplateBundlesCommand).

_role.comment: SV-5319: 5 retire-deferred carve-outs retired in full.  PRD §S22 matrix — Service Manager: full operational + AR/AP + reports + customer & billing portals; NO invoicingPaymentsDelete; settings limited to App + Wages. SV-7780: customerPortalPageAccess granted — the original "NO customerPortalPageAccess" spec was incorrect (FS triage). SV-8297: workOrdersDelete restored per current spec — Work Orders = View / Create & Edit / Delete (Delete ON). Reverses SV-8093 (spec v33 had Delete OFF); the current Permission Matrix now lists Svc Mgr = V/E/D for Work Orders.

PRD §S22 matrix — Service Advisor (= PRD "Senior Service Advisor"): full WO operations, customer V/E only (no DELETE), catalogInventory V/E only, NO settings. Customer portal. NO billingPortalPageAccess. Reports OFF per SV-8355 (reportsPageAccess removed); keeps seeFinancialData + seeApArData explicitly.

Net-new role per SV-7480 sub-A. No retire-deferred carve-outs (this role never existed pre-sub-B, so never held any of the 7 retire-deferred bundles).  PRD §S22 matrix — lighter-tier Service Advisor (slug service_advisor post-SV-7743; = PRD "Service Advisor" lighter tier): WO V/E only (NO delete), full WO workflow atoms (review/pick/order/full-view). Schedule V/E/D. Customers + part sales + catalog inventory + vendor + invoicing V/E only (no Delete; invoicing V/E only, no Delete per SV-8355). Timesheets View only. SV-5319: 5 retire-deferred carve-outs retired in full.  PRD §S22 matrix — Parts Manager: WO V/E (no DELETE), full WO workflow + lines CE only (no line delete). Schedule View only. SV-5319: 5 retire-deferred carve-outs retired in full.  PRD §S22 matrix — Parts Tech: WO View only, pick + order + full view (no review, no edit). Schedule View. Customers V/E. Part sales V/E. SV-5319: 3 retire-deferred carve-outs (TimeClock, ReturnsViewReceiveCredit, ReturnToInventory) retired in full. The legacy Office user could add deposits, take customer payments, issue credits and delete payments; the View-only custom mapping regressed all of those. Release blocker.

_role.comment: Net-new role per SV-7480 sub-A. No retire-deferred carve-outs (never existed pre-sub-B).  SV-8061 (2026-07-14) — the Sales Rep matrix was updated 2026-07-07 (Confluence "Custom Roles and Permissions" 565116952, confirmed authoritative by Sasha Grosman on the ticket 2026-07-13). Sales Rep is NOT "Reports only": per the updated matrix it holds Work Orders View, Customers View + Create/Edit, and Part Sales View in addition to View Mode Full + Reports + See Financial + See AP/AR. WO Lines View is inherited from Work Orders View (the spec marks WO Lines View as not independently configurable), so no WOL bundle is added. Everything else stays OFF: Schedule, Catalog/Inventory, Vendor/Order, Invoicing, Timesheets, all portals, all settings, review/pick/order, and history logs.  The stale pre-SV-8061 set granted only the 4 non-area bundles (woFullViewMode, reportsPageAccess, seeFinancialData, seeApArData), which rendered as "Reports only" and dropped Customers + Work Orders access for migrated Sales Reps. The spec's role-description text ("Reports and financial data access only") is stale against its own matrix; the matrix wins per Sasha's 2026-07-13 ruling.  This one mapping feeds BOTH the default system role ({@see InsertDefaultRolesCommand}) and the template snapshot ({@see InsertRoleTemplateBundlesCommand}), so it fixes the default role and the create-from-template path together.

SV-7958: TimeClock is a minimal read-only role per spec — Work Orders=View, Schedule=View, Timesheets=View, everything else OFF, View Mode none. The old TimeClock FE bundle was retired in SV-5319 (2026-06-05), which left this role mapped to an EMPTY bundle list — so it granted zero atoms and the user was denied even on its three allowed areas (Defect A).  Restored by granting the three view bundles. Per the FE-bundle-as-boundary policy (locked spec §5) we accept the silent transactional atoms these bundles resolve (e.g. workOrdersView resolves WORK_ORDER::CREATE_AND_EDIT, INVOICE::CE, NOTE::*) exactly as Technician / Office roles do — we do NOT strip them. No View Mode bundle is added (View Mode stays none). Basic clock in/out remains available structurally via {@see Role::getClockCapableTemplates()}, independent of any bundle assignment.
